positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Service Mesh engineer contributing on Box's Platform as a Service (PAAS) with a focus on service mesh migration from Synapse-Envoy (Smartstack) to Istio, involving hundreds of micro service applications
- Drove mission critical application migrations from on-prem data centers to Google Cloud
- Develop platform checks to ensure compatibility and correctness for GCP & Istio migrating services.
- Develop default alerting for Sidecars utilized on delivery platform
- Participated in on-call rotations for the Service Mesh team, providing Service Mesh (Smartstack and Istio) and Kubernetes support.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Supported engineering effort to transition monolith software product to microservices with a focus on Docker containers 
- Developed microservice messaging framework and message model for REST and Websocket communication
- Established cloud deployment for software products and support services using Packer, Terraform and Amazon Web Services. 
- General software engineering support for CI/CD builds, onboarding interns and new hires to agile process and collaborating with technical writers and PMs

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Created Java solutions to perform batch updates or increase efficiency for clients.
- Developed library of tools for internal code base.
- Practiced the agile development process with business analysts and product managers two week scrums.
- Technologies used: Java, SQL, XML, Net Beans IDE, IBM Data Studios, Git

certifications.name: Oracle Certified Associate, Java SE 8 Programmer
